name: Ferienwohnung Luislhof
beschreibung:
Situated in the idyllic mountaineering village of Obernberg am Brenner, the historic Luislhof provides an authentic Tyrolean farmstead experience. Cosy apartments crafted with natural timber feature modern comforts and vistas of the majestic Obernberger Tribulaun.

The protected area around turquoise Lake Obernberger See and countless hiking or ski touring routes begin right outside your door.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Luislhof in Obernberg am Brenner offers mountaineering village charm and pristine nature immersion in the Wipptal.
